name: Gill Robb Wilson Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 178 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.6875 x 0.6914 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.6875 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body scale 289.9 px per in, body width 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away) (upright body, hang angle -0.33 deg removed); compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

match_note: CAP body: the existing asset id and width of assets/medals/medal-cap-gill-robb-wilson-ribbon-miniature; ribbon_ref as that asset

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

generator: artwork-samples/assets/medals-work/design/gillrobb.js (parameters in inches) over lib.js, common.js, font.js, emit.js; gates: kitA.js; node makeA.js gillrobb --write
source_raster: vanguardmil.com product civil-air-patrol-gill-robb-wilson-miniature-medal (civil air patrol gill robb wilson miniature medal), 600 x 600 px, measurement reference only

source_product.title: civil air patrol gill robb wilson miniature medal
source_product.note: measurement reference only: never shipped, never committed

measured.photo: gill-robb-wilson.jpeg (Vanguard photograph, 600 x 600 px, reference only)

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: the engraving grain (dark pits, crystalline texture) of the ground and of the wing face: flat tones are drawn
the exact curvature of the wing's trailing edge (a shallow convex curve of 0.006 in sag is drawn through 3 read points)
the dot after AIR is read as an interpunct of 0.0033 in radius (a 22 px blob in the photograph)

palette.ramp: silver studio ramp (lib.js SILVER_RAMP), tones picked from the reference luminance classes

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (bail axis at the box top where the box cuts the ring)

ribbon_attach_units.basis: bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away)

fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 25/26): every object (disc, rim, lettering, emblem parts, bail, ring) is modelled as what it is, from measured parameters, not traced; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame (design/kitA.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26). Measured from gill-robb-wilson.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Silver miniature, plain silver (no gold). The reference shows this medal: arrowhead / swept wing, 13 stars, CIVIL AIR PATROL top, GILL ROBB WILSON bottom. Hang angle -0.33 deg of the photograph removed: the body hangs upright.
